mapper.sql: select a.id, a.type, a.receiver, a.status, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.dept_id, a.dept_name, a.del_flag from t_mail_forewarning a
mapper.delete: update t_mail_forewarning set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

update t_mail_forewarning set del_flag = '1' where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: select distinct su.email from t_mail_forewarning a left join sys_user su on su.user_id regexp( select replace ( a.receiver , ',', '|' )) where a.`type` = #{type} and a.del_flag = '0' and a.status = '0' and su.email is not null and su.email <> ''
